title: Biodegradable alginate–sericin biofilm: a colorimetric indicator using mangosteen-peel anthocyanins for protein food freshness
content:

Thi-Hong-No Nguyen, Minh-Truong Truong, Minh-Ty Nguyen, Quynh-Nhu Pham, Dinh-Tri Mai, Thi-Quynh-Nhu Ngo, Thi-Ngoc-Mai Tran, Ngoc-Bich-Tuyen Nguyen, Chi-Hien Dang, Huu-Trung Nguyen, Cao-Hien Nguyen, Thanh-Danh Nguyen
In this work, a fully biodegradable pH-responsive film was fabricated from sodium alginate and silk sericin, with anthocyanins extracted from discarded mangosteen peel (ASA) serving as the natural chromatic indicator.
